name: Koemanda Saburou
source:
The photographer chosen to shoot [url=/c156955]Wakana[/url]'s first photo book.
A longtime fan of Wakana as a cosplayer, he earned the role thanks to his passion and exceptional skills displayed at cosplay photo events.
Beyond cosplay photography, he has an unwavering love for Akihabara's otaku culture and its many forms of content, earning the respect of fellow fans and industry staff alike.
Having finally fulfilled his dream of purchasing his own studio and establishing Studio Koemanda, his latest concern is that he's completely drained his savings.

[From in-game profile]
